scenario_summary: Customer is locked out of their account due to missing credentials and is requesting a refund without an order number.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Lakisha Jackson and I'm 43. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.

Hello Lakisha, I understand how frustrating it can be to lose access to your account while traveling. For your security, I cannot access account details based on name alone. To assist you, I need to verify your identity using a few other data points. Could you please provide the billing address associated with the account and the approximate date of the transaction you are looking to refund?
Oh, okay. The address is 123 Maple Street, Springfield, and I think the purchase was around June 15th. Does that help?

Thank you, Lakisha. I have located a matching account profile. To ensure I am speaking with the account holder, could you please confirm the last four digits of the credit card used for that purchase and the total dollar amount of the transaction?
Yes, it was card ending in 4492 and the charge was for $89.99.

Thank you for that verification. I have successfully authenticated your account. I see the transaction from June 15th for $89.99. Per our 'Refund Policy 402-B', we can process a refund for items returned or cancelled within 30 days. Since this falls within that window, I have processed the $89.99 refund back to your card ending in 4492. You should see the credit in 3-5 business days.
That is such a relief, thank you so much for your help today!

You are very welcome, Lakisha. I'm glad we could get that sorted for you. Since you are having trouble with your login credentials, I have sent a password reset link to the email address on file, which I can confirm is l.jackson@email.com. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer's identity using billing address, transaction date, card ending, and amount. The refund was processed according to policy 402-B.
